name: The Ravaged Caravan
summary: Near Stonebull Lake, The Ravaged Caravan still draws Venture Company salvagers. Morin Cloudstalker sends travelers to inspect the wreckage after tauren warriors burned the convoy in retribution for lost companions. Intact crates reveal the industrial scale of Venture Company operations in Mulgore.

sections.title: Retribution by the Lake
sections.body: Tauren warriors burned a Venture Company convoy after an earlier skirmish cost them two companions. Morin Cloudstalker and his warriors struck swiftly, then torched the wagons to drive out the armed intruders. They left the smoking wreckage, believing the fire would consume whatever the goblins had come to haul.

sections.title: Unfinished Business
sections.body: Venture Company salvagers returned to the blackened wreckage, suggesting the fire had failed to destroy the most crucial cargo. Morin now sends scouts to inspect the remains rather than risk more lives blindly. Intact crates among the soot-stained debris bear the Venture Company Mining Division insignia. They are packed for shipment to central processing facilities.

faq.answer: Morin Cloudstalker and his tauren warriors ambushed and burned the caravan in retribution after two of their scouts were killed in an earlier skirmish with the Venture Company.

faq.q: Where is the Ravaged Caravan located?
faq.answer: The burned wagons lie along Stonebull Lake’s northern shore, east of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

faq.q: Why are the goblins returning to the wreckage?
faq.answer: The Venture Company sent salvagers because the fire failed to destroy all its cargo. They seek to recover durable supply crates marked for shipment to its central processing operations.

faq.q: What is inside the supply crates?
faq.answer: The crates bear the Venture Company Mining Division insignia and hold mineral resources labeled for refinement and processing at the company’s primary industrial plants.
Morin Cloudstalker is a tauren scout and tracker stationed east of Bloodhoof Village. He monitors hostile incursions across central Mulgore, particularly those from the Venture Company.

faq.q: What does this caravan reveal about the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The caravan shows the Venture Company’s presence in Mulgore is more than a mere exploratory team. It is an organized industrial extraction effort with armed supply lines and centralized refining networks.

angles.text: Venture Company machines desecrate the plains, and its timber-clearing strikes directly at your ancestral homeland. Recovering and destroying its supplies helps defend Mulgore.
Unchecked corporate expansion into Mulgore threatens Thunder Bluff’s stability, so Horde scouts must disrupt Venture Company logistics.
The sturdy crates and logistics notes show the Venture Company’s aggressive mineral surveying and extraction operations across Mulgore.
